newsitem.title: USA: ATT declines comment on Stet report.
newsitem.headline: ATT declines comment on Stet report.

text.p: AT&T Corp declined comment on Italian press reports that a broad-based alliance was imminent with Italian state telecommunications holding company Stet.
Stet denied the reports but said the group was in continuous contact with several foreign telecoms groups.
An AT&T spokeswoman said, "Our policy is not to comment on any talks we may be having. We don't comment on rumors or speculation."

The financial daily Il Sole 24 Ore said a possible strategic alliance between Stet and AT&T could involve either Stet entering the Unisource consortium, which Spain's Telefonica would leave, or the two groups creating a new consortium to take part jointly in the privatization of Brazil's state-owned telephone company Telebras.
Il Sole also speculated that Stet and AT&T had examined the possibility of a share swap or even AT&T taking a stake in Stet.
